prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 组件版本兼容矩阵 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "组件" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 112px
  col 2: header "v1.x" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 62px
  col 3: header "v2.x" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 4: header "v3.x" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 171px · one-line width 494px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 575px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 574px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示各组件在三个主版本中的兼容状态，并补充版本限制和迁移注意事项。","reading":"读者先按组件定位行，再横向比较 v1.x、v2.x 和 v3.x 的支持状态，最后阅读说明；也可能纵向扫描某个版本的兼容性。","groups":["v1.x、v2.x 和 v3.x 是同一角色的比较列，宜保持等宽，便于横向比较。","组件列是行标题；说明列补充同一行的兼容条件。"],"keep_intact":["版本号、SDK、MySQL 8.0 等标识符，以及说明中的长连续字符串。","支持状态中的符号与文字应尽可能保持在一起。"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文句子可自然换行，并可利用由其他单元格换行产生的行高。","组件名称可在自然位置换行，但应保持每行与其支持状态的对应关系清晰。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [94, 83, 83, 83, 231] · table 575×570px · row heights [36, 83, 83, 60, 83, 60, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [106, 83, 83, 83, 219] · table 575×593px · row heights [36, 83, 83, 60, 83, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [90, 83, 83, 83, 235] · table 575×547px · row heights [36, 83, 60, 60, 83, 60, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"三个版本列等宽，支持状态和表头均保持单行，便于横向比较；说明中的长标识符保持完整。组件列的底色也有助于按行定位。","problems":"多个组件名称被拆成两行，说明列的换行使多数数据行达到三行高；认证与授权 SDK 的说明尤其分散，OIDC 单独落在末行。","cause":"组件列为 94px，可用文字宽度为 73px；说明列为 231px，可用文字宽度为 210px，尚不足以容纳部分句段。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"三个版本列等宽且支持状态保持单行；较宽的组件列让部分名称首行容纳更多文字，说明中的长标识符也保持完整。","problems":"组件名称仍要换行，部分名称末行只剩一两个字；说明列更窄，日志采集插件的说明增加到三行，表格因此更高。组件列增加的宽度没有换来足够明显的阅读收益。","cause":"组件列增至 106px，仍不足以让最长名称单行显示；说明列缩至 219px，导致更多说明句段换行。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"三个版本列等宽，状态均为单行；说明列稍宽，使认证与授权 SDK 的说明缩为两行，整体行高更紧凑。组件名称与对应状态仍容易沿行读取，长标识符保持完整。","problems":"多数较长组件名称仍分两行，部分断点并不理想；最长说明仍占三行，版本状态单元格因此留下较多空白。","cause":"组件列为 90px，文字区仅 69px；说明列为 235px，文字区为 214px，仍不足以让所有长说明缩为两行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r3A","widths":[86,83,83,83,239],"change":"在 r2C 基础上将 4px 从组件列移给说明列，保留三个版本列的等宽和状态单行，观察说明是否进一步缩行，以及组件名称的断点是否仍自然。"},{"name":"r3B","widths":[82,83,83,83,243],"change":"进一步扩大说明列，测试较窄的组件列是否仍能保持可接受的名称换行，并判断更多说明空间能否改善行高和句段分布。"}]}
